name: Shinji Minamoto
source:
Likes: Jewelry, atypical experiences, Strawberry Pocky 
Dislikes: Being mistaken for a girl, Haru

His androgynous looks makes him a perfect rising star fashion model.
Not knowing what modesty is about, he is quite open about his feelings.
